bio: Rekki ran off young to become an assassin-for-hire, only to come limping home to Remnant with a host of injuries – and bounty hunters not far behind. She wanted to start over, but her Clan wouldn't let her; even temples need assassins. Now Rekki fights for a higher cause than coin.
